provider: Tencent Cloud Database (TencentDB for MySQL and Redis)
category: managed MySQL and Redis databases billed by subscription or pay-as-you-go; database free use is a new-user trial or a for-fee resource pack

free_tier.stated: No standing free tier for TencentDB for MySQL or Redis is published. Free use comes as a time-limited new-user product trial, listed among over 30 trial products, and for Redis as a赠送 (complimentary) standard bandwidth allowance by instance specification. TencentDB for MySQL free backup space is granted by region (100% of local-disk instance storage, 200% of cloud-disk instance storage).
free_tier.notes: The trial is open only to product new users and expires; a trial instance can be renewed in the console before expiry. The cost calculator states that price accuracy requires login. No always-free database allocation was found on the pages read.

per_object_cap.stated: No single-object cap is published for the database engine on the pages read; storage is provisioned at purchase and storage beyond the purchased size is billed pay-as-you-go

retention.stated: the new-user trial expires; before the product expires the user can renew it in the product control panel; a pay-as-you-go instance is billed for as long as it exists
retention.notes: null because the trial length varies by product and no single fixed clock is published; the finding is that the free use ends at trial expiry.

egress.terms: Public network traffic fees are currently free.

interface_detail: the MySQL and Redis wire protocols; a TencentDB API and the Tencent Cloud CLI
tooling: mysql and redis-cli clients, the Tencent Cloud CLI, and the TencentDB console
chaining: a trial TencentDB instance can back an application on a Lighthouse or CVM instance in the same region; the trial expiry governs how long the chain runs free

limits.value: the free product trial is only open to new users of the product; users who have purchased or tried the product cannot join, and an unpaid order occupies the trial qualification
free backup space is 100% of local-disk instance storage by region, or 200% of cloud-disk instance storage; storage beyond the purchased size is billed pay-as-you-go

binding_note: the trial is gated to product new users and ends at expiry; there is no always-free database allocation, so eligibility ends free use before any storage or backup limit binds

identity_cost.detail: Registration takes an email address, a Google account, or WeChat. Step 3 requires a name, address, industry and a mobile number with a verification code. Step 4 requires a card binding: the signup page states to enter card information to complete card binding and lists VISA, MasterCard, AMEX, UnionPay, JCB, DISCOVER and Diners Club, with a USD 1.00 pre-authorisation. Identity verification to use services in the Chinese mainland requires an ID card, passport, driver's license or work permit (individual) or a business registration document (enterprise).

reliability_note: an unpaid trial order occupies the trial qualification; a pay-as-you-go instance keeps billing until the user destroys it
confidence_note: four first-party Tencent Cloud pages were captured and quoted on 2026-11-19: the free-tier page, the MySQL billing overview, and the signup documentation. No probe was run; the trial and identity facts are stated on those pages.

evidence.quote: The free product trial is only open to new users of the product.
evidence.proved: database free use is a new-user trial, not a standing free tier

evidence.quote: Q Why can't I participate in the free trial? A The free product trial is only open to new users of the product. Users who have purchased or tried the corresponding product (including annual and monthly subscriptions and pay-per-use) are not eligible for this activity.
evidence.proved: prior purchase or trial of the product makes a user ineligible

evidence.quote: Q Why can't I experience it after canceling my order? A If an order is placed without payment, it will occupy your purchase experience qualification.
evidence.proved: an unpaid order consumes the trial eligibility

evidence.quote: Traffic fees | Public network traffic fees are currently free.
evidence.proved: public network traffic has no stated per-GB charge

evidence.quote: For cloud disk instances, the free backup space size is 200% of your instance's storage space.
evidence.proved: free backup space on cloud-disk MySQL instances is 200% of instance storage

evidence.quote: The monthly price for a 4-core, 8000MB instance in the Guangzhou region is USD 120/month. Memory specification fee = 2 × USD 120/month × 1 month = USD 240.
evidence.proved: a paid two-node 4-core 8000MB MySQL instance costs USD 120 per node per month in Guangzhou

evidence.quote: Tencent Cloud accounts can be registered using an email address, a Google account, or WeChat (you can choose any one of these methods to sign up):
evidence.proved: the first registration gate is an email, Google account, or WeChat

evidence.quote: 4. Enter the mobile number of the registration location.
evidence.proved: a mobile number with a verification code is required in the account completion step

evidence.quote: Enter your card information correctly to complete the card binding. Seven types of credit cards/debit cards/prepaid cards are supported: VISA, MasterCard, AMEX, UnionPay, JCB, DISCOVER, and Diners Club.
evidence.proved: a card binding is a required step to register a Tencent Cloud account

notes: TencentDB has no standing free database tier on the pages read. The free path is a new-user trial among over 30 trial products, gated to product new users. Registration itself needs a phone number and a card binding, and mainland service needs identity verification. The developer-tier price quoted is USD 120 per node per month for a two-node 4-core 8000MB MySQL instance, not a free allowance.
